name: Stella (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Stella (a tower beneath a star on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI STELLA in black above.
history: Municipal flag of Stella, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Stella arms — tower beneath a star on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI STELLA above the arms
